hero.title: AI Training Foundations
hero.body: Learn how professional AI evaluation works, practice on realistic examples, test your readiness, and earn a Certificate of Completion.

audiences.title: I'm completely new
audiences.body: Build the fundamentals before you spend hours applying blindly.

audiences.title: I created accounts but feel stuck
audiences.body: Understand the skills behind common evaluation tasks and practice them systematically.

audiences.title: I passed onboarding but have little/no work
audiences.body: Strengthen transferable evaluation skills while keeping expectations realistic about project availability.

audiences.title: I want a structured starting point
audiences.body: Use one practical path instead of piecing together scattered videos and forum posts.

faq.a: No. The foundations course focuses on general evaluation skills. Some third-party opportunities may require specialist technical or professional expertise.
